VBO:0201363.summary: Keenly observant and responsive to its people, the Toy Manchester Terrier often takes time to assess strangers with reserve. This athletic small terrier shares the Manchester enthusiasm for activities such as agility and scent work. Its quieter habits can be equally distinctive: seeking a close seat beside familiar people and burrowing beneath blankets.
VBO:0201363.shortDescription: An observant, athletic terrier, the Toy Manchester often seeks close company and enjoys burrowing beneath blankets.

sources.title: Canadian Manchester Terrier Club: Manchesters as Pets
sources.evidence: Opening paragraph explicitly covers both varieties: close proximity to their people, athletic ability and enjoyment of dog sports. Following character paragraph describes keen observation, responsiveness and reserve toward strangers. Final habits paragraph documents renowned burrowing under blankets.

sources.title: Canadian Manchester Terrier Club: CKC Toy Manchester Terrier standard
sources.evidence: Toy standard explicitly limits weight to12lb/5.5kg and requires natural erect moderately narrow pointed ears, long narrow almostflat wedge head, black/tan short glossy coat, slight loin arch, compact feet, and complete moderately short tapering tail no higher than back.

sources.title: American Kennel Club: Manchester Terrier (Toy)
sources.evidence: About the Breed distinguishes Toy not exceeding12lb from Standard not exceeding22lb while stating same temperament and body type. Manchester is spirited, bright and athletic with ratting and rabbit-coursing roots; exercise section describes active swift athletic dogs. Exact Toy gallery item1 reviewed live.
